message:
The other day, I was in the middle of a stormy evening, and I thought I was all set with my trusty phone charged and ready to go. I had my weather app open, planning to track the storm's movements like some sort of amateur meteorologist. And then, just as the heavy rain started, my phone decided it was time to take a nap—battery dead! 

There I was, staring out the window with no idea if I should be building an ark or just brewing some tea. It reminded me that while tech is great, having a good old-fashioned battery-operated radio or a stash of candles can save the day when the lights—and the phone—go out. 

What do you keep on hand for those tech-free moments?
